exercises.instruction: Match these words with their opposites.
Look at the pictures and answer the questions.
items: Example: A E I O U Which letter is in the middle? ..........I..........
1 What is there on the front of the car?
2 What is there on the back of the car?
3 What is there on the side of the car?
4 What is at the beginning of the path?
5 Who is in the middle of the path?
6 What is at the end of the path?
8 Where is the photograph? .................. Lucy's desk.
9 Where is the boy sitting? .......... the front of the class.

exercises.instruction: Choose the best words from the box to fill the gaps in the email.
items: I'm writing this from my computer at home ......... . No one else is (1) .................. . The children are (2) .................. at a friend's house just down the street, and Will is (3) .................. for a few days.  He's on business (4) .................. , in a small town in the (5) .................. of France. He'll be (6) .................. on Friday.

He's just sent me an email to say that it's lovely and hot (7) ..................!  I can only see rain from the window on my (8) .................. as I type, and the TV says that it's raining (9) .................. in this country.
I wanted to plant some flowers at the (10) .................. of our house but it's too wet to be in the garden.
So I'm just going to read a book until it's time for the children to come home.
